headline: Air Marshal Vivek Hande takes over as DGMS (Air)
fullText:
Ministry of Defence

Air Marshal Vivek Hande takes over as DGMS (Air)

01 SEP 2026 9:45PM by PIB Delhi

Air Marshal Vivek Hande, AVSM, VSM, took over as the Director General Medical Services (Air) on September 01, 2026 on permanent secondment to the Indian Air Force. An alumnus of Armed Forces Medical College, Pune; Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai; and National Defence College, New Delhi, he was commissioned in December 1988. He is a gastroenterologist of national repute and has tenanted many specialist and administrative appointments in his illustrious career.

Air Marshal Vivek Hande now has the privilege of serving in all three services of the Defence Forces. As a Flag Officer, he commanded Indian Naval Hospital Ship Asvini and was the Senior Consultant Medicine thereafter. On the elevation to the rank of Vice Admiral, he held the critical appointment of DG (Organisation & Personnel) in the Office of DG Armed Forces Medical Services before assuming his present appointment.

(Release ID: 2305760)
summaryText:
### OVERVIEW
Air Marshal Vivek Hande assumed the role of Director General Medical Services (Air) on 1 September 2026, on permanent secondment to the Indian Air Force, bringing extensive medical and operational leadership from across the Defence Forces.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS
- Assumed charge as Director General Medical Services (Air) on 01 September 2026
- Posted on permanent secondment to the Indian Air Force
- Commissioned in December 1988; holds AVSM and VSM decorations
- Educational background: Armed Forces Medical College Pune, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, and National Defence College New Delhi
- Recognised gastroenterologist of national repute
- Previously commanded Indian Naval Hospital Ship Asvini
- Held the appointment of DG (Organisation & Personnel) in the Office of DG Armed Forces Medical Services after elevation to the rank of Vice Admiral
- Entitled to serve across all three services of the Defence Forces

headline: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the virtues of giving fearlessness and saving lives
fullText:
Prime Minister's Office

Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the virtues of giving fearlessness and saving lives

02 SEP 2026 8:50AM by PIB Delhi

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the virtues of giving fearlessness and saving lives.

The Prime Minister wrote on X;

"अभयस्यैव यो दाता तस्यैव सुमहत्फलम् ।

न हि प्राणसमं दानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते ॥"

Whoever takes away people's fear receives great blessings, and in all three worlds, there is no greater gift than saving a life.

अभयस्यैव यो दाता तस्यैव सुमहत्फलम् ।

न हि प्राणसमं दानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते ॥ pic.twitter.com/PS3svT2yra

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 2, 2026

(Release ID: 2305791)
